description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between accuracy, measured in percentage, and token count for different prompting methods. The horizontal axis displays the prompting methods: CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, listed in that order from left to right, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, has a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. A secondary vertical axis on the right, labeled “Token Count”, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 100. Four bars are present, each representing a different prompting method and colored as follows: CoT is red, CoD is orange, CCoT is light blue, and CoUT is green. The CoT bar reaches approximately 91.19%, the CoD bar reaches approximately 88.40%, the CCoT bar reaches approximately 80.89%, and the CoUT bar reaches approximately 534.24%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
